text:
SAFEMED V, BCSEA II and IPA III Steering Committees meet in Brussels
On 23 and 24 November, EMSA hosted in Brussels, at premises provided by the Directorate-General for Enlargement and the Eastern Neighbourhood (DG ENEST), the Steering Committee meetings of the SAFEMED V, BCSEA II and IPA III projects.
The meetings brought together beneficiary countries, the European Commission, EMSA and relevant regional and international partners.
Participants reviewed progress made during 2026 and discussed technical assistance and capacity-building priorities for the year ahead, providing the basis for the preparation of the 2027 Action Plans.
Representatives of DG MOVE, DG ENEST, DG MENA, and DG MARE, as well as the European External Action Service (EEAS), contributed to the discussions, alongside the beneficiary countries and regional partners, including REMPEC, the Union for the Mediterranean (UfM), the Black Sea Commission, the Mediterranean MoU and the Black Sea MoU.
Discussions focused on ensuring that future support remains responsive to identified national and regional needs, while addressing areas such as maritime safety, security and environmental protection, regulatory alignment and compliance capacity, and the increased use of digital maritime services.
The two meetings also provided an opportunity to strengthen coordination among beneficiaries, EU institutions, EMSA and partner organisations and to look ahead to the next phase of regional cooperation and technical assistance.
